resources.string: At night, while the phone charges on Wi-Fi, the apps you already have are updated. You do not need to do anything.
Your parents update the apps on this phone. Ask them if an app says it needs an update.
Want a new app? Ask a parent. They can add it to your phone.

At night while the phone charges on Wi-Fi, or when a parent asks, the apps you have can update. A new app installed then stays hidden until your parents say yes. Your parents see when it happened and how many apps were updated.
